sentences: Hitting Set asks for a small collection of elements that intersects every set in an input set system.
Bounding the system's VC-dimension limits its shattering complexity and supports strong approximation results, but does not automatically make exact optimization tractable.
The source asks whether Hitting Set remains \(\mathrm{W}[2]\)-hard even when the VC-dimension is bounded by a constant.
Here the parameter is the size of the requested hitting set, so the target is a stronger parameterized hardness classification within a structurally restricted family.
An answer would sharpen the distinction between low-dimensional sampling structure and the difficulty of finding an exact small transversal.
